SoildTech PlantSenso Handles AI Plant Care While You Travel

By
Tom Payne
-
September 8, 2026
0
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 3:09
Instaread

IFA 2026, taking place in Berlin from September 4-8, is Europe’s largest annual consumer technology event, where global brands unveil their latest innovations, including the SoildTech PlantSenso AI plant care.

SoildTech PlantSenso AI plant care

SoildTech is bringing PlantSenso to IFA Berlin 2026, pitching it as an AI plant-care companion for people who want their houseplants to be a bit clearer about whether they are thriving or slowly dying while they are away.

The product is a desktop device that sits with a potted plant and uses an integrated probe to monitor soil moisture, temperature, ambient light and nutrient levels.

Instead of presenting that information as a dashboard full of percentages, PlantSenso turns the readings into a pixel-art character with real-time expressions.

That is where the Tamagotchi comparison comes in.

IFA 2026, running from 4–8 September at Messe Berlin, is Europe’s biggest annual consumer technology show. It’s a key date for travel-tech enthusiasts, when brands unveil new gadgets, smart luggage, and connected gear designed to make life on the move easier.

The event welcomes both industry and the public, offering hands-on time with products that could shape your next trip.

See All IFA 2026 Launches

PlantSenso is designed to make caring for houseplants feel more like checking in on a digital pet, except this one has roots and will absolutely judge your watering habits.

The device shows a mood on its built-in display, while the companion app adds generative AI voice interaction, letting users talk to their plant and receive plain-language care guidance.

For travellers, the useful part is less about novelty and more about confidence. Anyone who has returned from a work trip or long weekend to a crispy windowsill casualty will understand the appeal of a device that makes care needs easier to interpret before leaving and easier to review after getting home.

PlantSenso guides and explains care rather than physically looking after the plant by itself, so nobody should sack off watering entirely and blame the gadget.

SoildTech says PlantSenso is designed for beginners, Gen Z users, millennial families and gift buyers looking for design-led tech. The company describes the experience as “de-sensor-ized”, replacing intimidating charts with low-barrier visual alerts, a companion app, care guidance and a visual memory journal.

The model on show at IFA also includes an NFC-powered tap-to-play ecosystem. With supported connected accessories, such as auto-waterers, plant-food pods and grow lights, users can tap to log care events, trigger in-game milestones, collect digital postcards and unlock rarity badges. NFC can also be used for quick plant profiling at nurseries or friends’ homes.

“We are shifting away from rigid, tool-type utility devices to create a true companion product,” said Luke Tan, Founder and CEO of SoildTech. “By grounding plant care in gamified interactions, collectable milestones, and portable design, we are eliminating plant anxiety and helping everyday plant lovers build joy and habit-forming connection with their green spaces.”

The hardware includes a 1000mAh rechargeable lithium battery with up to 21 days of operation, plus magnetic and USB-C charging.

PlantSenso has already completed a Kickstarter campaign with more than 500 early backers, following appearances at CES 2026 and BEYOND Expo 2026.

Its IFA Berlin showcase marks the product’s formal debut in the European market.

Pre-orders are due to open in September 2026 at plantsenso.com (price TBC), with first deliveries expected in Q4 2026.
